name: Shower Remodeling
summary: Custom shower remodeling with demolition, waterproofing, tile installation, niches, benches, plumbing fixtures, drains and frameless glass enclosures.

faqs.question: What is included in a custom shower remodel?
faqs.answer: A complete shower remodel may include demolition, framing repairs, plumbing changes, waterproofing, tile installation, niche or bench construction, drain work, fixtures and glass installation.

faqs.question: Can a bathtub be converted into a walk-in shower?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many existing tub areas can be converted into walk-in showers after evaluating the drain location, plumbing, wall framing, waterproofing requirements and available dimensions.

faqs.question: How long does a shower remodeling project usually take?
faqs.answer: Many custom shower projects take about one to three weeks depending on demolition, repairs, waterproofing, tile complexity, material availability and glass fabrication.
